newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MITI says still room for economic growth.
newsitem.headline: Japan MITI says still room for economic growth.

text.p: Japan's economy is continuing its gradual recovery, but there is room for more growth, Japan's newly appointed Trade Minister Shinji Sato told a news conference on Friday.
"It is generally said that the economy is gradually recovering, but (I think) it's still not enough," Sato said.
"Some things have recovered but some haven't. That's why we end up using the phrase 'gradual recovery'," he said, adding that the most important task was to stabilise the recovery.

On trade issues, Sato said Japan's most important relationship was with the United States, but with issues such as cars and semiconductors "going fine", the focus has now shifted to developing relationships with other countries, particularly neighbouring Asian nations.
